scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @shop/contracts && npm run build -w @shop/catalog && npm run build -w @shop/localisation
scripts.dev: npm run seed && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green --kill-others "npm run dev -w @shop/api" "npm run dev -w @shop/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @shop/contracts && npm run test -w @shop/catalog && npm run test -w @shop/localisation
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @shop/web && npm run test:unit -w @shop/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w @shop/web && npm run test:integration -w @shop/api
scripts.smoke: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.verify: npm run format && npm run check:localisation && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
